info.name: MessMate · 01 · Auth
info.description:
Login, token ar password.

**⭐ "Login — Owner" ar "Me" — ei duita age chalao.** Token, messId ar membershipId auto-save hobe, tarpor baki sob folder kaj korbe.

Ei folder ta **order-safe**: puro folder run korle shesh-e tumi Owner hisebe logged in thakbe. Role bodlanor request gulo "11 · Security"-te, ar bipojjonok gulo "12 · Destructive"-e alada rakha ache.

Token duivabe jay: httpOnly cookie (Postman nijei rakhe) ar Bearer header (`{{accessToken}}`).

request.description:
**Ki kore:** Notun user account banay ar sathe sathe login kore dey (token feriye dey).

Email-e `{{$timestamp}}` ache, tai **proti bar notun account** toiri hobe — `409` ashbe na. Email ta `joinEmail` variable-e save hoy; "03 · Members"-er join flow eta use kore.

**Rules:**
- Password minimum 8 char, ekta boro hater + ekta choto hater + ekta digit
- Eki email diye abar dile `409`
- `phone` optional

**Cheshta koro:** password `abc` diye pathao — `400`, ar kon rule bhengeche seta `details`-e dekhabe.

**Expect:** `201`

exec: try { pm.environment.set("joinEmail", pm.response.json().data.user.email); } catch (e) { /* no environment selected */ }

request.description:
**⭐ Sob cheye age eita chalao.**

**Ki kore:** Login kore access + refresh token dey. Test script token ta `accessToken` variable-e save kore, tai erpor sob request nijei authorized hobe.

**Ei account ta OWNER** — sob kaj korte pare (month reopen, role change, ownership transfer).

**Expect:** `200` + user object + token.

exec:
pm.collectionVariables.set("accessToken", pm.response.json().data.accessToken);
try { pm.environment.set("accessToken", pm.response.json().data.accessToken); } catch (e) { /* no environment selected */ }

pm.collectionVariables.set("userId", pm.response.json().data.user.id);
try { pm.environment.set("userId", pm.response.json().data.user.id); } catch (e) { /* no environment selected */ }

request.description:
**Ki proman kore:** Bhul password-e `401` ashe, ar message-e "email ta ache kina" seta faash hoy na — `Invalid email or password` dutoi khetre eki. Eta ichchhe kore kora, jate keu email probe korte na pare.

**Expect:** `401`

**⭐ Login-er por eita chalao.**

**Ki kore:** Ekhon ke logged in ache, ar se kon kon mess-e ki role-e ache seta dey.

Test script prothom mess-er `messId` ar `membershipId` save kore — baki sob folder ei duita variable use kore.

**Expect:** `200` + `memberships[]` array.

exec: try { pm.environment.set("messId", m.mess.id); } catch (e) { /* no environment selected */ }
try { pm.environment.set("membershipId", m.id); } catch (e) { /* no environment selected */ }

request.description:
**⭐ Login ar Me-r por eita chalao.**

**Ki kore:** Mess ekhon kon mase ache seta ene `periodId` variable-e save kore.

**Keno ekhane:** "04 · Meals", "05 · Expenses" ar "06 · Deposits" folder-er kichu request-e `periodId` lage, kintu "07 · Periods" folder ta pore ase. Tai setup-ta ekhane sere neowa hoy — na hole oi request gulo khali `{{periodId}}` peye `400` debe.

**Note:** mash ta na thakle server nijei toiri kore dey, tai maser 1 tarikhe-o kaj kore.

**Expect:** `200`

exec:
pm.collectionVariables.set("periodId", pm.response.json().data.id);
try { pm.environment.set("periodId", pm.response.json().data.id); } catch (e) { /* no environment selected */ }
console.log("periodId =", p.id, "(" + p.year + "-" + String(p.month).padStart(2, "0") + ") status=" + p.status);

request.description:
**Ki kore:** Refresh cookie diye notun access token dey.

**Important — rotation:** proti refresh-e purono session revoke hoye notun ekta toiri hoy. Tai **eki refresh token duibar use korle** system dhore ney token ta churi hoyeche, ar oi user-er **sob session revoke** kore dey.

**Cheshta koro:** eita duibar por por chalao — dwitiybar `401` ashbe, ar tumi logged out hoye jabe. Erpor abar login korte hobe.

**Expect:** prothombar `200`

exec: try { pm.environment.set("accessToken", pm.response.json().data.accessToken); } catch (e) { /* no environment selected */ }
